milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The iron_ore vein is embedded in a stone cliff centered at spawn-relative (4, 1, 4). The player spawns ~5.7 blocks away, so max_distance=5 requires them to walk closer to the ore wall (closing the gap from 5.7 to within 5 blocks). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the ore, confirming they have visually identified it. This combination prevents trivial satisfaction at spawn while remaining achievable with minimal movement.

Uses inventory_has because this is a craft task and the crafted iron_shovel ends up in the player's inventory. The player must smelt iron_ore into iron_ingots using the furnace (with coal as fuel), then combine 1 iron_ingot + 2 sticks at the crafting table to produce an iron_shovel. The player starts with zero iron_shovels, so any iron_shovel in inventory (min_count=1) confirms the craft was completed successfully.
